event: Nala lies still in the dark and listens to the low voices beyond the walls.
prose: You lie still and listen. You want a word out of it, one whole word, any word at all.

event: She sorts them: two or three deep voices, and one close above her that hums as it talks.
prose: First you sort the voices. Two deep ones, maybe three, a little way off. And one close above you, a woman's, that hums between the things she says, as if she can't quite stop.

memory.fact: Beyond the walls: two or three deep voices, and a woman's close above that hums between words.
Beyond the walls: two or three deep voices, and a woman's close above that hums between words.
Beyond the walls: two or three deep voices, and a woman's close above that hums between words.

event: They talk low and quick; the rise and fall carries, but the sounds smear like talk underwater.
prose: They talk low and quick. You can follow the shape of it, a question going up at the end, an answer coming down flat, someone cutting in. The sounds inside the shapes smear together, like people talking at the bottom of a swimming pool.

memory.fact: Through the walls, voices come as blurred hums; their rise and fall carry, few sounds do.
Through the walls, voices come as blurred hums; their rise and fall carry, few sounds do.

event: She strains for any piece she knows; nothing in the rhythm sounds like English at all.
prose: You strain after any piece you might know. A the, an and, a yes. The beat of it is wrong for English, though. The stresses land in odd places, and the sounds run on without the little stops you'd expect between words.

memory.fact: The talk beyond the walls has a rhythm wrong for English, its stresses landing in odd places.

event: Her window opens on a new Path: Path of Eavesdropping.
prose:
You keep at it a good while, and words open in your mind.

:::skill
name: Path of Eavesdropping
:::

So the listening counts for something, even if you can't make out a single word yet.

memory.fact: Listening to the voices, her window showed a new Path: Path of Eavesdropping.
Listening to the voices, her window showed a new Path: Path of Eavesdropping.
Listening to the voices, her window showed a new Path: Path of Eavesdropping.

event: She pushes harder, spreading her soul out to the body's edges to press closer to the voices.
prose: You push harder. You spread yourself out through the body, into the fingertips and the soles of the feet and the curve of the back, as close to the wall as you can get, as if getting nearer would let the words through.

event: Her whole small body jerks with the effort, and a heel drives hard into the wall of the womb.
prose: The body doesn't take it the way you meant. All of it jerks at once, the way a leg kicks out when you're falling asleep, and one heel drives hard into the wall.

memory.fact: Straining to listen, her whole body jerked and a heel drove hard into the wall of the womb.
Straining to listen, her whole body jerked and a heel drove hard into the wall of the womb.

event: The humming voice gasps; the talk beyond the walls stops dead. She has caught no whole word.
prose: Above you the humming voice gasps. The talk beyond the walls stops dead, in the middle of a sound, and you still haven't got one whole word out of it.

memory.fact: At her kick, the humming woman gasped and the talk beyond the walls stopped dead.
At her kick, the humming woman gasped and the talk beyond the walls stopped dead.

event: A hand presses flat on the outside, right over her, then a second, heavier hand beside it.
prose: Something presses flat against the wall from outside, right over you: a hand, warm through everything between. Then a second one beside it, wider and heavier, pressing harder.

memory.fact: After her kick, a hand pressed flat over her from outside, then a second, heavier one.

event: A deep voice murmurs close against the wall, slow; the hands stay, pressing, waiting.
prose: A deep voice starts up, close to the wall now, low and slow, the same few sounds over and over. The hands stay where they are and keep pressing.

memory.fact: A deep voice spoke close to the wall, low and slow, the same few sounds over and over.
